headline: Nifty Reclaims 23,200 Amid Metal Gains and Saudi Crude Supply Disruptions
why: Metals and FMCG sectors outperformed ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting
Nasdaq futures rose as falling oil prices mitigated global inflation concerns
Direct tax collections grew 13% reflecting robust domestic economic growth
Market snapped a two-day losing streak despite pressure on IT stocks
whatHappening: Saudi Aramco suspended crude deliveries to India after a pipeline attack
Indian bonds faced a fifth weekly loss due to RBI moves
The Rupee closed unchanged at 95.89 against the U.S. Dollar
India announced the 2027 launch of the Qdenga dengue vaccine

summary: The Nifty 50 reclaimed the 23,200 level as strong performance in Metals and FMCG offset IT sector weakness. Investors weighed positive domestic tax collection data against supply chain risks from Saudi Aramco's crude halt. Global cues remained mixed with US futures rising while Indian bonds faced persistent selling pressure.
